recommendation: One exact-branch creation push producing one workflow job, one fresh hosted macOS ARM64 VM. Fixed Room A0 then Room/Redact/Trip A-before,B-env-only,A-after. Maximum ten discovery calls. Supersedes A/A-only proposal because A/A alone does not address env-policy contrast.

historical_identity.evidence: Room Q9/Q11 hosted-identity; Redact Q25 failure job log; Trip C21 host-capability/receipt/job log (referenced by prior reports).
historical_identity.guard: Historical ImageVersion is a reference, not an admission requirement. All comparisons use one current standard hosted macos-15 ARM64 job and the same installed pinned Xcode16.4/16F6/SDK18.5. Record image/Python/OS differences; this is a current-image diagnostic, never historical reproduction.

phase_labels.A0: First measured simctl query in this job; not certified cold. Record all non-simulator preflight.
phase_labels.room_A_before: Immediate repeat of A0 under original Room env policy.
phase_labels.other_A_before: First for boundary after earlier boundaries; not cold.
phase_labels.B: Only admitted frozen parent env-bundle added; original argv/stdio/session/mask/command caps preserved.
phase_labels.A_after: Restore exact A env; not a service-state reset.

env_B_contract.reject: NUL/CR/LF/control characters, overlength or unknown format. Any present invalid key skips entire B; never partial intervention.
env_B_contract.formats: Exact regexes frozen in plan: XPC_FLAGS numeric hexadecimal/decimal, __CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING canonical hex triple, XPC_SERVICE_NAME restricted ASCII label characters. No permissive fallback or arbitrary parent-env forwarding.
env_B_contract.absent_or_equal: Absent keys remain absent. If no actual A/B delta, skip B with typed reason and no duplicate process. Unexpected original A key membership is a boundary mismatch.
env_B_contract.proof: Assert exact dict diff(A,B) is only admitted three-key additions. Restore A in finally; parent environment unchanged. Snapshot once, not each phase.
env_B_contract.publication: Only key/presence/admissibility/length/digest/change flag. Raw values private. Hash is comparison metadata, not a confidentiality guarantee.
env_B_contract.meaning: Parent metadata-string bundle, not transferred bootstrap port, GUI/audit session or credentials. Session and signal-mask hypotheses untested.

declared_diagnostic_deltas.adapters: Exact vendored class/function bodies and dependency hashes; explicit diagnostic constructors/context. Production mains/host guards not invoked or spoofed. Changed context/observations are declared deltas.
declared_diagnostic_deltas.session: start_new_session=True remains on every arm; original signal masks and cleanup order retained.
declared_diagnostic_deltas.RLIMIT_FSIZE: Latest candidate sets global8MiB soft RLIMIT_FSIZE for the whole diagnostic process and all arms; preserves hard limit and restores original soft value in finally. Record old/new/restore values. Never raise a stricter pre-existing limit; a stricter limit is a nonmatching-policy result.
declared_diagnostic_deltas.RLIMIT_confound: FSIZE covers ALL regular-file writes, including tool/cache writes, not just logs. It can itself alter discovery; the delta applies to all three boundaries. Holding it equal within ABA permits this diagnostic-regime contrast, not historical equivalence.
declared_diagnostic_deltas.censor: Any SIGXFSZ/EFBIG/output cap is OUTPUT_LIMIT_CENSORED and stops remaining probes; never interpret as env failure or historical timeout reproduction.
declared_diagnostic_deltas.post_return_guard: Added Redact post-return owned-group absence check is declared cleanup delta; no new acceptance claim. Any uncertainty stops.
declared_diagnostic_deltas.equivalence: Original command function bytes can be preserved while full historical context is not. Report command-boundary reuse plus explicit deltas, never full historical replication.
declared_diagnostic_deltas.environment: One current hosted image and common installed Python3.12–3.14, no Python installation. Workflow explicitly sets DEVELOPER_DIR to installed Xcode16.4 for all phases. Room/Trip canonicalize this path; Redact retains the workflow-provided value. Global Xcode default can differ and is recorded. No xcode-select mutation.
declared_diagnostic_deltas.supervisor_signals: Declared supervisory delta shared by all arms: require inherited SIGUSR1 unblocked with default disposition, then install owned SIGUSR1 soft-deadline exception and SIGTERM InterruptedError handlers. Restore prior handlers on normal exit. No signal-mask changes and no change to original Room SIGALRM masking. Redact/Trip retain their scoped handlers and restore the outer handler.

metadata.identity: Actual source seal/commit binding, run/attempt, fixed guarded job/ref/workflow, ImageOS/ImageVersion, OS build, machine/Python version and Python binary hash. Source seal supplied independently, not generated from live checkout.
metadata.xcode: Installed pinned Xcode and SDK versions plus tool hashes; record whether global selected symlink matches the pin and hash its path. Prospective PATH lookup is not proof of child executable image.
metadata.env: Freeze actual per-boundary env privately; public fixed-key typed presence/equality/digest only. Preserve inherited PATH differences and missing DEVELOPER_DIR.
metadata.rlimits: Read fixed available AS CORE CPU DATA FSIZE NOFILE NPROC RSS STACK soft/hard values; explicit infinity/unavailable. Capture before/after blocks and global FSIZE restoration. Apart from declared FSIZE delta no changes. Parent readings are inheritance policy evidence, not live child/kernel-policy proof.
metadata.process: Supervisor numeric UID/EUID/GID/EGID/PID/PPID/PGID/SID and narrow acquired-child identity if instrumented; no whole-machine process listing.
metadata.output: Only explicit public/diagnostic.json plus optional fixed public/hard-deadline.json are uploaded. Hard receipt dominates stale partial diagnostic success. Private logs/env are never upload paths. Inventory JSON is not parsed or accepted for runtime selection; command success only means process return plus cleanup.
metadata.preflight: Filesystem/plist/hash reads only. No native version command, simctl warmup, UI, boot/reset, service restart, cache clearing or downloads. A0 remains first measured, not certified cold.

continuation.advance: Only after durable receipt, stable source/env identity, bounded output and confirmed leader reap plus owned-group absence with no ownership/cleanup errors. A normal timeout may advance to its predeclared contrast only with those clean postconditions and remaining budget; record timeout as failed/censored.
continuation.abort_all_later: Unknown spawn/group, EPERM/error in ownership observation, cleanup error, identity drift, receipt failure, output limit or insufficient reserve. No extra child for uncertain-group inspection, retries, killall or unrelated service/device cleanup.
continuation.outer_guard: Killing only the supervisor group does not stop start_new_session command groups. Candidate must prove nested ownership registration/accounting; otherwise UNKNOWN/UNRESOLVED and stop, never report cleanup complete.
continuation.states: Distinguish COMMAND_FAILED_CLEANED, OWNERSHIP_UNCERTAIN, OUTPUT_LIMIT_CENSORED and NOT_RUN reason.
continuation.hard_fallback: Hard receipt, when present, overrides any earlier diagnostic.json success state. cleanup UNKNOWN; no further probes or retry; runner teardown is delegated to hosted runner lifecycle, never claimed confirmed by the diagnostic. No runtime acceptance follows from COLLECTED/complete telemetry alone.

budget_proposal.arithmetic: Room4*60 + Redact3*(60+3) + Trip3*60=609. With45s preflight and30s reserve,684s nominal leaves96s overhead within780; no original per-command limit increases.
budget_proposal.admission: Require full original phase allowance plus global reserve before each phase. No deadline reset for B/A-after. Skipped B never authorizes another probe.
budget_proposal.outer: Driver780s including preflight; work ends750s with30s receipt reserve. Step14min and job20min independent backstops. Queue/checkout/upload separate.
budget_proposal.interrupting_watchdogs: Owned daemon watchdog: soft absolute deadline started+45 for preflight, then started+750 for the whole work sequence. It signals only the captured supervisor PID with SIGUSR1, never descendant groups. Immutable hard timer started+780 writes a fixed HARD_ABORT/cleanup UNKNOWN receipt best effort and exits124 even if the receipt write fails. Failure to deliver the soft signal also triggers the unresolved hard-abort callback. No automatic retry.
budget_proposal.bound_limit: Python timers/signals require interpreter/OS scheduling; this is not a real-time guarantee against kernel/interpreter stalls. Step14min/job20min remain independent hosted backstops. Hard fallback or hosted cancellation cannot prove descendant cleanup; mark unresolved and stop the series.

interpretation.pattern: Room A0 slow/fails, immediate A-before faster
interpretation.not_proven: True cold/warm cause, permanent warmup or env effect.

interpretation.pattern: A-before fails/slow, B passes/fast, A-after fails/slow
interpretation.not_proven: Causality, individual key effect, bootstrap repair or release acceptance. Timeouts are censored latencies.

interpretation.pattern: A-before passes, B fails/slow, A-after passes
A-before fails, B and A-after pass

interpretation.supports: No successful query under either policy within this sample budget

counterexamples: Background services, scheduling and load can oscillate ABA with no env effect; one block has no error-rate estimate.
Stopping a timed-out earlier request can warm or poison shared services. B inherits that state and A-after cannot erase history.
XPC_SERVICE_NAME copying presents parent metadata but does not recreate Mach bootstrap/audit/session identity.
Global FSIZE can affect tool/cache writes and introduce a new failure, even though allarms receive the same limit.
Full inventory versus runtimes-only, FILE versus PIPE and different wait/pump semantics confound cross-boundary speed comparisons.
Only A0 is first measured; later boundaries are already exposed to earlier queries. Even A0 may follow hosted-provider initialization.
A current image can differ from historical runs, and same image/arch is not same worker/service state. Image/Python changes are explicitly reported without claiming reproduction.
Discovery does not exercise Files launch/terminate/EPERM5624, UI Runner delay, backup/restore, signing or App Store publication.
code_review_gates: Verify complete dependency graph and module-import/constructor side effects before native use.
Verify A/B differs only by admitted env inside declared diagnostic regime.
Verify outer deadline handles nested sessions conservatively; supervisor exit cannot prove children stopped.
Verify FSIZE failure has independent censorship status and restoration, including exceptions.
Verify no raw env/log/process/private-path publication on any sanitizer/persist failure.
Actual candidate needs independent source review and a separate finite execution grant; no uninspected executable is approved here.

Review changed push-event guard, literal source-seal binding and isolated branch trigger. Final launcher hash and signed commit must be reviewed before the only push; no default-branch registration workaround.

deployment.future_gate: Review exact isolated branch commit and literal package seal hash, then coordinator GO before ONE branch-creation push. No PR, main mutation, manual dispatch, extra validation push or retry. Existing product CI triggers only push to main and pull_request; confirm remote workflow inventory before push.
deployment.source_binding: Package seal covers runner/adapters/guard/tests/plan/vendor only. Launcher is excluded to avoid self-referential seal embedding; launcher SHA is independently reviewed and bound by final signed commit. Workflow embeds literal seal SHA. Expected source SHA from github.sha is a context-consistency check, not independent approval; coordinator reviews the actual signed commit before its only push.

host_gate.ImageVersion: actual current value recorded; numeric format only
host_gate.mismatch: Architecture, Xcode16.4/16F6/SDK18.5, supported Python or hosted identity failure refuses before simulator queries. ImageVersion drift alone does not refuse. No substitutions, retry or installation.
host_gate.python_scope: One common installed interpreter is constant within the job. Room historical3.12.10, Travel3.14.7, Redact exact version not retained; not full historical equivalence.
host_gate.trigger: push only, exact refs/heads/diagnostics/ios-discovery-20261027-a1, attempt1; bounded event JSON requires created=true, forced=false, deleted=false, before=40zeros, after=expected commit and exact repository/ref.
host_gate.repeat_policy: Workflow job also requires branch creation and attempt1, so ordinary updates/reruns do not acquire a macOS runner. Branch must be absent remotely before the authorized creation push; do not delete/recreate or retry.

runner_image_availability.read_evidence: Official arm64 README currently lists ImageVersion20260907.0337.1, macOS15.7.9/24G830, Python3.14.7, installed Xcode16.4 default build16F6 at /Applications/Xcode_16.4.app, SimulatorSDK18.5.
runner_image_availability.immutable_pin: No immutable ImageVersion selector was identified in official standard hosted label documentation. macos-15 selects the OS/architecture channel; images are updated. Current documented version matches historical, but actual job version remains authoritative.
runner_image_availability.execution_decision: Use current-image diagnostic and explicit installed Xcode pin; do not spend a run deliberately requiring obsolete ImageVersion equality. Coordinator must review final source before one execution.
